semiconductor_relevance: High — Solar Plus specializes in manufacturing semiconductor tapes and adhesive films critical for wafer processing.
summary: Solar Plus Company, established in 1980, is a leading manufacturer of high-performance tapes and adhesive films for the semiconductor industry in Taiwan. Their product offerings include UV release tape, wafer back grinding tape, and thermal release tape, which are essential for various semiconductor production processes.
capabilities: UV release tape for wafer back grinding and dicing
Thermal release tape for semiconductor applications

regional_presence.Taiwan: Solar Plus is based in Taiwan, a leading country in the semiconductor industry, focusing on supporting local semiconductor manufacturing.
